taiwan_insert.title: 氟黴寧靜脈注射劑1公克 Flumarin for Injection 1g, 衛署藥輸字第024321號 (台灣塩野義製藥; mfr Shionogi Pharma Kanegasaki Plant, Japan)
taiwan_insert.version: 修訂日期 2025年3月; PDF uploaded 2025-05-28 (older PIv7 2019-08-19 also listed, file corrupt)
taiwan_insert.note: License derived from NHI code BC24321209. PDF has no text layer; text file is a manual transcription from page images. Insert gives NO numeric renal dose table (only: reduce dose / extend interval; T1/2 table by CrCl and HD T1/2). Adult 1-2 g/day in 2 doses IV/IV infusion, up to 4 g/day in 2-4 doses; children 60-80 mg/kg/day in 3-4 doses (max 150 mg/kg/day); neonates 20 mg/kg 2-3x/day (day 0-3) or 3-4x/day (day 4+).
